name: Junk Titan
description: Junk Titans were bits and pieces of trash held together by Kazdan Paratus' Force powers. They were part of Paratus' private army of junk golems. Starkiller faced at least four of these on Raxus Prime before confronting Paratus himself.

data.name: Junk Titan
data.creator: Kazdan Paratus
data.retired: 3 BBY (after the death of Kazdan Paratus)
